_install: mv ~/Downloads/swarm_tiers.json ~/.claude/skills/pr-release-gate/scripts/  — written here because the background-isolation guard blocks writes into the shared ~/.claude checkout.
_provenance: MEASURED, not chosen by reputation. Two runs. (1) 2026-08-25: swarm_bench.py ran 142 feasible OpenRouter models (text, ctx>=320k) against swarm_bench_corpus.json - four real defects from the 2026-08-17 Pi-Dev-Ops release-gate session. Result: 7 perfect, 84 partial, 51 zero. (2) 2026-09-18: re-ran the SAME corpus against the whole live FREE field (21 models) after the founder directed that OpenRouter be used as a free-model harness. Result: 0 perfect, 15 partial, 6 zero. Raw: free-bench.json in that session's scratchpad.
_headline_2026_09_18: NO free model scored 4/4 on the re-run, including nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free, which scored 4/4 in August and 3/4 today - and took 223.4s against 26.8s in August. Six models scored 3/4. The free tier below is therefore a PANEL of five 3/4 scorers from five different families, because corroboration across independent families is what compensates when no single free model finds everything. Do not read 3/4 as 'nearly 4/4' for one model: read the panel.
_nondeterminism_warning: Free models are nondeterministic even at temperature 0, so a single benchmark run is ONE SAMPLE, not a ranking. nemotron moving 4/4 -> 3/4 and 26.8s -> 223.4s between runs is that effect, not necessarily a regression. Re-run swarm_bench.py before trusting any ordering here, and never promote a model to a tier on one run.
_availability_warning: Catalogue presence is NOT availability. On 2026-09-18 six models scored 0/4 purely on HTTP: thinkingmachines/inkling{,-small}:free returned 403 'only available on agentic harnesses' (a server-side allowlist of apps listed on openrouter.ai/apps - honest HTTP-Referer/X-Title attribution does NOT unlock it, and impersonating a listed app is not an option), while google/gemma-4-*:free and poolside/laguna-*:free returned 429. Only nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning:free scored 0/4 with no error, i.e. genuinely missed every defect. Probe before trusting: ~/.claude/bin/free-models -n 8 --probe.
_cost_basis: USD per full ~300k-token review (300k prompt + 8k completion).

free.note_2026_09_21: deepseek-v4-flash-0731:free was delisted from OpenRouter free (404; absent from /api/v1/models on 21/09/2026). inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante:free returned HTTP 400 on a real CCW-CRM review that day. Both were replaced by nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free and laguna-s-2.1:free, which each returned parseable reports on real CCW-CRM reviews on 21/09/2026. The replacements are NOT benched on swarm_bench_corpus.json; re-run swarm_bench.py to score them. Both nemotrons are one family, so this panel is four families, not five.
free.note: Five 3/4 scorers, five distinct families (nex-agi, inclusionai, dots-studio, deepseek, nvidia). Was two models in the August config; the free field has widened a long way since. openrouter/free ALSO scored 3/4 and is deliberately EXCLUDED - the August run recorded it returning a schema template instead of a report, which is a false green, and nothing since has disproved that.

free_fast.note_2026_09_21: inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-sante:free replaced by poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free after an HTTP 400 on a real CCW-CRM review. laguna was the fastest parseable reviewer that day (40s on an 88 KB diff) but is unbenched and occasionally returns 'Provider returned error'. The 'Both 3/4' note below describes the old pair.
free_fast.note: Both 3/4 and both under 20s, for iterating on a diff. Two families is thin corroboration - use `free` for anything that gates a release.

mixed.note: WAS the default for release gating. WARNING measured 2026-09-18: the two PAID members both return HTTP 402 'requires more credits' at a $0 OpenRouter balance, so this tier silently degrades from a three-family panel to a single free model while still reporting as `mixed`. Prefer `free` until the balance is funded, or pass --models explicitly.

max.note: Every 4/4 scorer in the August field. All but the first are PAID and will 402 at a $0 balance.

_notable_underperformers.note: 2026-09-18. 550B parameters, 1M context, and it still returned no_choices on one case. Size did not predict defect detection, same lesson as the August frontier models above.

_underperformer_note: Recorded to stop reputation-based tier selection creeping back in. This is one corpus of four defects, so it measures defect-mechanism naming on THESE defects, not general capability - but it is measurement, which is more than a guessed list.
